based_on: 0.3.0-draft front rig (unchanged) + NEW side-view rig + NEW shared gait driver
status: side-view rig + front/side walk, motion-tested (draft). NOT approved, NOT promoted to library
interpretation: 'jalan ke samping, tampak samping' = true side/profile view walking (character faces screen-left like the reference sheet; facing='R' mirrors it). Front walk = walking toward the camera.

what_is_new.side_rig: ucup_side.py: profile head (nose, ear, backwards cap with front strap arch and short rear visor, rear hair mass), side torso with partial logo, near/far arm and leg (far limbs shaded darker), side sneaker. Built from the reference side view. Same palette, joint heights and dimensions as the front rig.
what_is_new.gait_driver: gait.py: ONE sagittal-plane walk (1.0 s cycle, 60% stance, step 140 px, heel-strike -> flat -> heel-off -> swing). IK per leg, planted contact (heel then ball pivot), hip bob 8 px, arm swing opposite to the same-side leg.
what_is_new.front_walk: walk_front.py: front rig driven by the SAME gait via projection: thigh scale = cos(thigh angle), shank scale = cos(shank angle), hip height identical, hip tilt/sway/twist, arm foreshortening. ucup_rig4.py = ucup_rig3 + leg_override.

leg_mapping: leg A = near leg (side) = screen-RIGHT leg (front); leg B = far = screen-LEFT. Arm A is on the same side as leg A and swings opposite to it.

verified.stance_foot_slide_px_per_frame: max 0.09 (expected ground motion 4.67 px at 60 samples/cycle)
verified.loop_closure: pose difference frame 0 vs end of cycle = 0
verified.silhouette: single connected piece in all 60 sampled phases, side and front
verified.svg: no raster, no duplicate ids, all side expression/hand/cap/facing combinations render valid

unresolved: Front walk is a projection, not a true 3D turn: shoes do not show heel-strike/toe-off pitch (ankle y matches, shoe stays flat), and arm foreshortening is subtle.
No transition between front and side (no turning), no start/stop ramp, no run, no walk-away (back view not built).
Side view only has walking arms: hands = relaxed/fist; no side-view gestures (point, wave, etc.).
Profile expressions reuse the front parameters but are subtle (sad vs neutral is faint); wink and mask are not drawn in profile.
Cap-off profile hair is rough (front swoop not matched to any reference).
Small collar tick marks stick out at the neck sides in profile.
Facing right is a mirror: the partial chest logo is mirrored.
Far-side limb shading is a new choice, not taken from the reference.
Side rig proportions were checked by eye against the reference side figure only; cap tilt and visor length are approximations.
Not loaded or verified in MEKANIVO Motion; no library entry created.
